text:
Maria G: FYI scheduling a rolling maintenance window in us-central GPU pools tomorrow 03:00-07:00 UTC to address intermittent NVLink misroutes and a NIC microcode regression. Plan is 5 racks/hour, staggered cohorts. Expect short gRPC retries and transient queue spikes. @oncall please ack.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket MAINT-20231130-UC1-NICFW created. Affected pools: gpu-pool-us-central-1, gpu-pool-us-central-2. ETA 2023-11-30T03:00Z -> 07:00Z.

Kevin L: Ack. Quick Q — can we prioritize delaying dedicated tenant racks until later in the window? They have reserved capacity.

Maria G: Yes — sequence: non-dedicated -> low-util dedicated -> dedicated priority only if headroom <25%. We'll attempt traffic shift first.

Noah R: If a rack stalls, do we have cross-region backfill capacity? Streaming clients will notice increased tail latency when we shift.

Jess T: We can backfill to EU and US-west pools but streaming p99 will jump ~60-120ms based on the sim. Recommend deferring large streaming batch jobs through the window.

Linh P: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maints/uc1-rolling-nic-fw-check.md (see checklist + rollback conditions).

Maria G: Runbook TL;DR: cordon node -> drain with 60s graceful -> flash firmware -> NIC sanity checks -> NVLink validation -> uncordon -> seed prefix cache. We'll run a prefix cache seed after uncordon with: 
```
/tools/cache-seed --pool gpu-pool-us-central-1 --keys 1000
```

Kevin L: SalesHeads: we should send a customer heads-up to Dedicated customers 1h before start. Also, any expected quota/usage spike? Backfill/spot may increase spend.

Maria G: Agreed. We'll post to #announcements 1h prior and email top-10 dedicated customers. Estimated incremental cost for backfill/spot ~+$1.2k for the window. Finance pls track.

Jess T: Will draft comms. Aim to include: brief impact statement, mitigation, expected window, how to reach support. I can have draft by EOD.

Noah R: Suggest adding a canary: flash 1 node per rack (canary) then monitor RPC error rate for 15m. Abort if RPC error rate > 0.5% or NVLink remap errors reoccur.

Maria G: Canary plan included. Canary node -> 15m watch -> cohort if green. There is an auto-rollback flag in the playbook.

ops-bot: Canary check succeeded on rack-r01 at 03:05Z. Proceeding with cohort rollout. :white_check_mark: 

Kevin L: Also remember to temporarily raise autoscaler caps to avoid eviction loops during drain: 
```
kubectl patch hpa inference --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":120}}'
```
Make sure to revert after.

Linh P: Finance noted +1.2k. I'll create a cost tag MAINT-UC1-20231130 and ask billing to attribute.

Maria G: On-call schedule: @Kevin L will be primary, @Noah R secondary, ops rotation watching metrics and paging rules. If rollback happens, we'll open INC and follow postmortem flow.

Kevin L: I'll be on the channel from 02:45Z to 08:00Z.

Jess T: Comms draft posted to #announcements-drafts, linking to the runbook and an FAQ stub.

Noah R: One more: add a quick qdisc check after uncordon to ensure no packet drops on trunk interfaces: 
```
ssh node-xx
sudo tc -s qdisc show dev ens5
```
If drops > 100/s pause cohort.

Maria G: Good call. Adding to validation steps. Thanks everyone. Will post final reminder 1h before start. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MAINT-20231130-UC1-NICFW -> 2023-11-30T02:00Z (announce to #announcements).
